changelog: **A real VPAT 2.5 INT, generated from the repository's own evidence (#2037):** `src/lib/vpat.ts` holds every row — WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA complete (plus the AAA criteria the product can speak to), EN 301 549 V3.2.1 chapters 4–12 (clause 9 generated from the WCAG rows) and Revised Section 508 chapters 3–6 — with a conformance level, remarks and an **evidence** column (a repository path, a spec, an issue or a repeatable `check:`). `scripts/vpat-evidence.mjs` (`npm run vpat:evidence`) reads `e2e/a11y-baseline.json`, `e2e/a11y-scan.spec.ts` and `docs/a11y-audit.md` plus git and writes `docs/legal/vpat.md`, `docs/legal/vpat-evidence.md` and the generated `src/lib/vpatEvidence.generated.ts`; `scripts/test/vpat.test.mjs` fails on a `Supports` row without evidence, an evidence path that does not exist, a stale generated file or Markdown that differs from what the data renders. Published unauthenticated at `/accessibility/vpat` (translated chrome, English report) and `/accessibility/vpat.md` (Markdown is not in the image, so both render from the data), linked from `/accessibility` and `/trust`, listed in the public-route registry. The statement's closed `/account` select limitation (#2041) is retired and the review date moved; the open rows name #2864.

en: Procurement can now open our accessibility conformance report (VPAT 2.5): WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549 and Section 508, criterion by criterion, each row with the test or file behind it — from the accessibility statement and the trust page, no sign-in needed.
tr: Satın alma ekipleri artık erişilebilirlik uygunluk raporumuzu (VPAT 2.5) açabilir: WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549 ve Section 508, kriter kriter, her satırda arkasındaki test ya da dosya ile — erişilebilirlik bildiriminden ve güven sayfasından, giriş gerekmeden.
de: Die Beschaffung kann jetzt unseren Barrierefreiheits-Konformitätsbericht (VPAT 2.5) öffnen: WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549 und Section 508, Kriterium für Kriterium, jede Zeile mit dem Test oder der Datei dahinter – von der Barrierefreiheitserklärung und der Trust-Seite aus, ohne Anmeldung.
